food_name: Commercial-grade sesame seeds (Sesamum indicum L.), pooled study sample
synonym_verification_status: Exact individual sesamin was quantified using an authentic sesamin standard; Stage B identity audit complete
mapping_review_rationale: Source quantitatively measures individual sesamin by HPLC-DAD using authentic sesamin standard across 21 commercial sesame seed samples. Stage B exact identity is complete and the source analyte directly matches. Hold because seed roasting/processing state and fresh/dry moisture basis are not reported for the 3816.7 mg/kg mean; preserve as-analyzed study sample basis and source mean±SD/range. Do not treat aggregate mean as an individual seed sample or universal market value. Ingestion remains gated by Stage B checksum reconciliation.
moisture_basis: Not reported; as-analyzed sesame-seed sample basis
analytical_method: HPLC-DAD with authentic sesamin standard; retention time and peak area used for qualification/quantification
extraction_method: Sesame seeds powdered; oil extracted from 5 g by Soxhlet with n-hexane; extract oil analyzed by HPLC-DAD
sample_size: n=21 commercial-grade sesame-seed samples from 8 countries, collected 2015–2017
source_title: Determination and Daily Intake Estimation of Lignans in Sesame Seeds and Sesame Oil Products in Korea
database_reference: Kim et al. 2020, Results §3.2: sesame-seed sesamin 1568.4–7746.8 mg/kg; average 3816.7 ± 1414.2 mg/kg; n=21
extraction_notes: Kim et al. report mean 3816.7 mg/kg, SD 1414.2 mg/kg, range 1568.4–7746.8 mg/kg across 21 commercial-grade sesame-seed samples from eight countries, collected 2015–2017. Sesame seeds were powdered; oil was extracted from 5 g by Soxhlet with n-hexane and analyzed by HPLC-DAD with sesamin standard. This is a single aggregate candidate summary, not a per-sample record.
uncertainty_notes: Source reports mean ± SD 3816.7 ± 1414.2 mg/kg and range 1568.4–7746.8 mg/kg (n=21 seed samples). Countries represented: India (7), China (3), Korea (3), Ethiopia (2), Pakistan (2), Sudan (2), Nigeria (1), Paraguay (1). Roasting state and moisture basis are not specified; preserve source as-analyzed basis. These samples are commercial-grade and source-specific, not a global or retail-weighted mean.
